organization-e-health-effects.head: 92ebf6be
organization-e-health-effects.scope: The stock client toggled System Control 1169, Retribution 1173 and Champion of Zion 1177 from the hotbar (25 IS each, 25 IS per 5 s drain). With fixed callback rolls, ?health damage reapplied 1180 (State 102 Stun 5 s on QAEnemy and the Melee Dummy, the stock stun and 10 s immunity lines, later triggers refused by immunity), 1182 (150 to QAEnemy and the dummy, 30000->29850, the stock 'Your Retribution does 150 damage' line) and 1181 (CSR 4060->4310 and IS +25; QAFriend IS +25 with its heal capped at full health; nothing on QAFar or QAEnemy). Toggle-off removed each record, the stock client refused reactivation on the 240 s reuse, and later damage produced no callback.

controls.source: GOB 1180 applies Stun for 5 s with AddControlImmunityTimerVal 10 s; System Control's ApplyMachineEffectHealthChance reapplies it.
controls.runtime: AbilityHealthCallbacks reapplies 1180 on the 5% roll; TimedEffects applies State 102 for 5 s and the 10 s control-immunity window refuses a second stun.
controls.test: Stock PR1153: Stun 5 s on QAEnemy and the Melee Dummy removed at 5 s, the stock stun and immunity lines, and '[EFFECTS] 1180: control immunity, state refused' inside the window. OrganizationEffectTests.SystemControlStunsHostilesForFiveSecondsWithOneTenSecondImmunityWindow. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1153#issuecomment-7152808137

area.source: GOB 1180/1181/1182 store RadiusOfEffect 5 with the native default angle; tempmods.py 2621-2658 reapply them from the parent's health-change callback.
area.runtime: The effect admits legal hostile players and NPCs within 5 m and in sight of the owner.
area.test: Stock PR1153 stunned QAEnemy at 3 m and the dummy, excluding QAOther at 5.01 m by radius and QAFriend as not an opponent. OrganizationEffectTests.OrganizationEffectsDoNotAffectNpcsOutsideTheRadius. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1153#issuecomment-7152808137

script.source: tempmods.py AddControlImmunityTimerVal gives the stunned target 10 s of stun and pacify immunity.
script.runtime: The immunity window is recorded per target on application and consulted by the next 1180 application.
script.test: Stock PR1153 showed 'will be immune to stun and pacify for 10 seconds' and refused later stuns inside the window. OrganizationEffectTests.SystemControlStunsHostilesForFiveSecondsWithOneTenSecondImmunityWindow. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1153#issuecomment-7152808137

behavior-tests.source: System Control 1169 is a 25 IS toggle with a 25 IS/5 s drain and 240 s own and family-1178 reuse; a 5% roll on damage that leaves the owner below maximum health reapplies 1180.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHealthCallbacks, the AbilityBuffs drain and AbilityCooldowns implement the parent; direct casts of 1180 are refused.
behavior-tests.test: OrganizationEffectTests.OrganizationParentsAreSourcedTogglesWithFivePercentHealthCallbacks, OrganizationCallbacksRollOnlyForDamageThatLeavesTheOwnerBelowMaximum and the stock PR1153 toggle, drain, effect, toggle-off and reuse pass. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1153#issuecomment-7152808137

damage.source: GOB 1182 stores fixed neutral damage 150 with no caster scaling; Retribution's ApplyMervEffectHealthChance reapplies it.
damage.runtime: The effect deals neutral type 5 for a fixed 150 through ordinary NPC/PvP health handling, without a damage roll or influence.
damage.test: Stock PR1153: '1182 hits QAEnemy for 150' and the dummy 30000->29850, with the stock 'Your Retribution does 150 damage to QAEnemy.' line. OrganizationEffectTests.RetributionDealsFixedNeutralDamageOnlyToHostilesInsideFiveMetres. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1153#issuecomment-7152808137

area.runtime: Legal hostile players and NPCs within 5 m and in sight are hit.
area.test: Stock PR1153 hit QAEnemy and the dummy only. OrganizationEffectTests.RetributionDealsFixedNeutralDamageOnlyToHostilesInsideFiveMetres and OrganizationEffectsDoNotAffectNpcsOutsideTheRadius. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1153#issuecomment-7152808137

targeting.source: 1182 is an internal effect centred on the owner, not a cast with a selected target.
targeting.runtime: Direct casts of 1182 are refused; the callback admits targets by hostility, radius and line of sight.
targeting.test: Stock PR1153 hit both hostiles in sight and nothing friendly. OrganizationEffectTests.RetributionDealsFixedNeutralDamageOnlyToHostilesInsideFiveMetres. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1153#issuecomment-7152808137

behavior-tests.runtime: The same parent machinery as System Control 1169.

damage.source: GOB 1181 stores NeutralHeal 250 with no healing influence and ZionRestoreIS +25.
